pictures.name: JPK1-Dust
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. The dawn of the world on a wide plain of rich red-brown earth. In the middle distance lies a small, featureless shape of dark earth lying on the ground far away, softly veiled in golden dust and mist, only its outline suggested, no face and no body details, as if just shaped by a potter, edges still soft with dust. A warm gold light rises at the horizon, deep blue sky above. No other figures. Stillness before life.
